zh: Open-AutoGLM 任务状态机与超时优化：完整支持 completed 与 waiting_for_user（等待用户在手机登录/确认）状态，杜绝轮询死锁。
移动端流式心跳与实时进度保活：手机端自动化执行过程中实时下发阶段进度，防止 iOS/Android 网络连接空闲断开抛出 cannot parse response 异常。
设备并发接管与自动恢复：支持任务强制执行接管，前序挂起或等待任务自动终止，复合指令执行完成后自动回传最新手机屏幕画面。
en: Open-AutoGLM task state machine and lifecycle fix: full support for 'completed' and 'waiting_for_user' states, eliminating polling deadlocks.
Mobile streaming heartbeats and live progress events: continuous status updates during phone task execution to prevent iOS/Android idle connection drops.
Device takeover and automatic recovery: auto-terminate orphaned or blocked tasks when submitting new mobile instructions, auto-capturing screenshots upon completion.
